description:
Seen once on 2026-11-13 during a workspace gate run while another build was using the machine: the oracle check ran real elixir on fixtures/00691_a_child_and_its_parent_both_time_out_in_order.oracle.exs and elixir itself printed :main_timeout before :child_timeout, so the golden mismatched. fz was not involved; three re-runs alone passed.
Cause: the child times out after 20 ms and the parent after 80 ms; the order rests on the child being scheduled, started and printing within the 60 ms gap, which a loaded machine does not guarantee (BEAM start plus spawn can exceed it).
Done when: the fixture still shows a child and its parent both timing out, with the order fixed by a message between them and no dependence on a wall-clock margin; expected.txt regenerated from elixir; matches on interp, run and build.
title: Fixture 00691 orders its two timeouts by a message, not by a 60 ms margin
